text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian conquers the Derby, claiming 
her second crown. As the world buzzed with 
excitement, a press conference was held 
for Biwa Hayahide's entry in the 
"Takarazuka Kinen".

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the press conference, Biwa Hayahide 
declares her victory in the Takarazuka 
Kinen, followed by a promise of an 
eventual sister showdown against Narita 
Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Biwa Hayahide drawing more attention 
than ever, her Trainer diligently analyzes 
their opponents in order to support her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then, footage of the Derby catches her 
eye. On screen is the "Monster" Narita 
Brian, growing and evolving at a 
terrifying, abnormal pace.
